title: Home Mortgage Loans Mortgage Insurance Schedule by Program
content:
Insurance Administration maintains, for every Home Mortgage Loans program, the upfront premium financed at closing, the annual premium billed monthly, the loan-to-value figures at which private mortgage insurance attaches, may be cancelled on request and terminates on its own, the clean payment history a cancellation request calls for, and the number of years annual insurance runs on the FHA program.

## Premiums

| Program | Upfront premium financed, as a percent of the base loan amount | Annual premium, as a percent of the principal balance |
|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 1.75 percent | 0.55 percent |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 2.15 percent | 0.00 percent |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.00 percent | 0.46 percent |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.00 percent | 0.32 percent |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 0.00 percent | 0.46 percent |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.00 percent | 0.00 percent |

The upfront figure is the upfront mortgage insurance premium, or on the VA program the funding fee, financed as a percent of the base loan amount. The annual figure is the annual premium, billed monthly, as a percent of the principal balance.

## Private mortgage insurance figures

| Program | Insurance attaches above an original loan-to-value of | Cancellation may be requested at a loan-to-value of | Terminates on its own at a scheduled loan-to-value of | No payment 30 or more days late in the last | No payment 60 or more days late in the last |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 percent | 80 percent | 78 percent | 12 months | 24 months |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 percent | 80 percent | 78 percent | 12 months | 24 months |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 80 percent | 80 percent | 78 percent | 12 months | 24 months |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |

The two loan-to-value figures in the middle columns are taken on the original value. The last two columns are the months before a cancellation request over which the payment history must be clean of the stated lateness.

## Years of annual insurance on the FHA program

Annual insurance runs 11 years on the FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage where the original loan-to-value was 90 percent or less. The figure is not applicable on the VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, on either Conventional program, on the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage or on the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage.

Three of the six programs therefore carry the private mortgage insurance figures, and one of the remaining three carries a years figure of its own.
